about.heading:
Engineer at heart,
builder by craft.
paragraphs: I'm a full-stack developer with a soft spot for the whole pipeline — designing schemas, shaping APIs, and sweating the last few pixels of an interface. I care less about which layer a problem lives in and more about shipping something that feels effortless to use.

Over the last few years I've built real-time collaboration tools, edge-deployed services, and developer platforms used by teams in production. I write code that's a joy to maintain, document the why, and stay calm when the pager goes off.

items.description: Lead the platform team building real-time collaboration infrastructure. Cut p99 latency by 60% and mentored four engineers.
Shipped customer-facing features end to end across a Next.js + Go stack, and owned the design system used company-wide.
Designed APIs and data pipelines for a logistics startup, scaling from prototype to thousands of daily orders.
Started contributing to open source and never really stopped — where the code-blooded thing began.

quotes.text: Rishav ships features that just work. He thinks in systems and writes code that's a genuine joy to maintain.
